reasoning: A clear semicircular dial gauge with its needle pointing upper-left. It strongly cues physical gauges and meters (tire pressure, boiler pressure, utility meters, speedometers) as well as software dashboards, speed tests, and performance benchmarks. Distinctiveness is moderate only because icon sets usually include two or three nearly identical gauges with different needle angles.
